summary.result: If it is compared to selected foreign research results, about 10 water samples for each rainfall event were needed to compute the pollution load within 10% error.
summary.background: A monsoon season monitoring data from June to September, 2005 of a small forested watershed located at the upstream of the North Han River system in Korea was conducted to analyze the flow variations, the NPS pollutant concentrations, and the pollution load characteristics with respect to sampling frequencies.
summary.method: Flow-weighted mean concentrations of T-N, $NO_3$ -N and T-P during the period were 2.114 mg/L, 0.836 mg/L, and 0.136 mg/L, respectively.
